title: purge-artifacts schedule fails on GitHub API 500 listing artifacts (3 of last 4 scheduled runs)
roadmap_unmapped_reason: not set at filing -- manager to map to a milestone at the next weekly pass
note: Seen 2026-11-09 by manager 2026-11-07a. Scheduled runs: 11-06 10:28Z FAIL, 11-07 09:41Z FAIL, 11-08 09:55Z ok, 11-09 11:00Z FAIL (run 42605406980). Cause in the log: GET /repos/.../actions/artifacts?per_page=100 returned HTTP 500 'Unexpected end of JSON input' after ~8 s; github-script runs with retries: 0. Likely the artifact list is large and the API times out. Fix (Tier 1, small): set retries: 3 on the github-script step and page with a smaller per_page (e.g. 30), so an intermittent 500 is retried instead of failing the purge; then confirm the next scheduled run is green. Impact: artifacts are not reclaimed on failing days (storage creep), no trading impact. After the 11-11 reset.
